newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS 7-DAY REV REPO TENDER FOR FRI.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS 7-DAY REV REPO TENDER FOR FRI.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Friday it had set a tender for a seven-day securities reverse repurchase for 10 a.m. (0900 GMT), offering to drain a maximum 3.985 billion crowns from the market.
The NBS statement said that the American-style tender would have no fixed minimum rate.

According to official NBS figures, the banking sector has a liquidity surplus ahead of Saturday's minimum reserve deadline with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 102.96 percent as of Thursday, after 102.31 percent the previous day.
In the NBS's last reverse repo tender for a seven-day maturity on Thursday, the average rate was 14.95 percent, after 16.75 percent the previous reverse repo tender with a similar maturity.
The NBS said the Thursday's reverse repo cut was a signal to the market that rates should come down.
